label: Modal collapse: at every world, whatever…, from Gödel's 1970 axiom Ax2a: at every world… and 2 more
meaning: Modal collapse (the statement of Scott's MC) follows from Gödel's 1970 axioms Ax2a, Ax3 and Ax4, but only by explosion: they have no model with a world (GOEDEL-1970-INCONSISTENT), so modal collapse holds vacuously, and so would any statement about the model. The AFP theory GoedelVariantHOML1.thy does not state MC. Compared with Scott's modal collapse (SCOTT-MODAL-COLLAPSE), which is derived from satisfiable axioms through T3 and the essence of God-likeness, this result carries no information about the 1970 notions: it records that the consequence query has the same answer for a different reason. Formal consequence inside the Lean embedding of the AFP theory (DEF-HOML-ACTUALIST-NECESSITY) only: it shows nothing about what Gödel intended, how his manuscript developed, nor whether the axioms are true.
